newsitem.title: USA: Kushner-Locke gets $16 mln order from ABC.
newsitem.headline: Kushner-Locke gets $16 mln order from ABC.

text.p: Kushner-Locke Co, a movie production company, said Tuesday it had received a $16 million order from ABC Television, a Walt Disney Co unit, to produce an initial 13 episodes of "Cracker," a drama series.
The one-hour series is slated to premier in ABC's 1997-98 fall season, airing Thursdays at 9 p.m., said Peter Locke and Donald Kushner, co-chairmen of the production company.
"Cracker" is being produced in association with Granada Entertainment USA, whose parent, the British company Granada Television, has produced a series of the same title, Kushner-Locke said.

The U.S. series stars Robert Pastorelli as Gerry "Fitz"" Fitzgerald, a gambling psychologist who has a striking insight into the criminal mind but is unable to hold his own family together. The character assists police in solving crimes involving strange criminal behavior.
